_readme: Capability-skill registry — the SINGLE source of truth for which external
skill a task needs, where it comes from, and how it is installed.
It lives with the MCP server (not in the skill) because the `archgen_skills`
TOOL owns the matching + installation. The agent never edits this file and
never shells out to an installer by hand.
INSTALL MODEL — install EXACTLY ONE skill, never a bundle:
The `skills` CLI (npm package `skills`, from vercel-labs/skills) is
INTERACTIVE without --yes/--agent, so an automated install MUST pass them.
ON DISK — every skill lands as a DIRECTORY <root>/<slug>/SKILL.md:
symlink for Claude Code); it never writes .opencode/skills/ or
NO CLUSTERING: a task matches ONE precise skill. `policy: required` means
the skill is mandatory for that domain; `policy: on-demand` means it is
installed only when the task names the capability explicitly.

skills.purpose: Baseline UI conventions — spacing, typography, color, component primitives. The default UI quality bar.
Motion and animation performance — jank-free transitions, transform/opacity discipline.
Accessibility — keyboard, focus, semantics, screen readers, ARIA correctness.
Page/document metadata — titles, descriptions, social previews, canonical URLs.
Holistic UI review and improvement pass over an existing interface.
Component canvas — building and previewing component variants in isolation.
Authoring a DESIGN.md — the token and component contract a codebase's UI follows.
Scaffolding a new canvas/app shell from a UI brief.

routing._readme: The ui-skills-root entry routes a task to the right specialised skill. It is the fallback when a task touches UI but matches no specific skill above.
routing.purpose: Router for the ui-skills family — decides which specialised UI skill applies.
